title: UNSTRING ... DELIMITED BY — splits with COUNTERS for each receiving field; OVERFLOW on truncation
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PARSE-CSV.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-LINE     PIC X(80).
       01  WS-A        PIC X(20).
       01  WS-B        PIC X(20).
       01  WS-C        PIC X(20).
       01  WS-COUNT    PIC 9(3).
      *> Splits WS-LINE on ',' into 3 receiving fields. COUNT IN
      *> WS-COUNT records how many fields were extracted. ON
      *> OVERFLOW fires when there are MORE delimiters than receivers
      *> -- the extra content is silently dropped without OVERFLOW.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           UNSTRING WS-LINE
              DELIMITED BY ','
              INTO WS-A, WS-B, WS-C
              COUNT IN WS-COUNT
              ON OVERFLOW DISPLAY "too many fields".
           STOP RUN.
notes: UNSTRING is more powerful than String.split — it supports COUNT IN, multiple delimiters via OR, and the OVERFLOW branch. A naive String.split misses the overflow signal. Surface the COUNT semantic + OVERFLOW handler.
